name: Sort assumptions for proxies (a) and (d)

assumptions.a: Display order approximated by rank of FINAL net score among siblings (Reddit 'best' = Wilson lower bound on up/down votes; only net score is available). Ties broken by creation time, oldest first. Stickied and moderator-distinguished comments (pinned on top) cannot be identified (no 'stickied' field in GECLM comments) and are ranked by score like others. Collapsed/'load more' children are not modelled.
assumptions.b: Early-thread display order = arrival order (oldest first) among siblings: under 'best' new comments all start at score 1 (one self-vote), so their confidence is equal and Reddit's tie-break order is assumed chronological. HN early order assumed to follow arrival the same way.
assumptions.d: suggested_sort = 'new' shows top-level comments newest first; position(t) = 1 + newer top-level siblings so far. Assumes readers use the suggested sort (a reader can override it), stickied comments are not identified, and the sort applies from thread creation (snapshot value; see check 8).

notes: The assumptions cannot be verified with GECLM: no per-comment vote split, no stickied flag, no reader-side sort. Final-score ties among siblings are common (see result), so (a)'s tie-break matters.
